Class SocketClient

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.socket.client.SocketClient
public class SocketClient extends Object
Socket client implementation that listens for incoming messages and pings from the server. It manages dedicated threads to asynchronously process main game events and connection heartbeats, forwarding them to the ClientController.

  • Constructor Details

    • SocketClient

      public SocketClient(BufferedReader input, Socket socket, ClientController controller)
      Constructs a new SocketClient.
      Parameters:
      input - the BufferedReader used to read incoming messages from the server.
      socket - the primary Socket connection to the server.
      controller - the ClientController responsible for handling client-side game logic and updates.

  • Method Details

    • run

      public void run()
      Starts the main listener thread for the client. It continuously reads incoming messages from the server and handles them asynchronously.

    • runVirtualServer

      private void runVirtualServer() throws IOException
      Internal listener loop that reads serialized strings from the input stream, parses them into Event objects using the JSON codec, and forwards them to the controller.
      Throws:
      IOException - if an error occurs while reading from the stream or if the connection drops.

    • setPingSocket

      public BufferedWriter setPingSocket()
      Establishes a secondary socket connection on the server's adjacent port specifically for ping messages. Starts a dedicated listener thread to process incoming pings and keep the connection alive.
      Returns:
      a BufferedWriter associated with the ping socket's output stream, or null if the connection fails.

    • runPingClient

      private void runPingClient() throws IOException
      Internal listener loop for the secondary ping socket. Continuously reads incoming ping requests and notifies the controller to update the last seen timestamp.
      Throws:
      IOException - if an error occurs while reading from the ping stream.
